title: Example 191 through build.py: the joint example's run by jvmcontract compare
description: Runs example 191 (Phase 5 of llm-dlc/loops/foundations.md: the joint example made an example on the new shop app) through build.py's new runner run_tool_compare: the app compiled unpatched and patched, its tests run, then jvmcontract compare twice under one fresh proof cache, the verdict read from the rerun's JSON and the page from the first run's text and SARIF. The same verdicts came inline from jvmcontract compare on the app's builds; this run is build.py's first on the runner, so it checks the runner and the page too. Expected: violation: Pricing#total refuted on new Quote(new Money(0), 1), 0 before and 1 after, replayed on a JVM; POST /quotes refuted too; every part of the rerun an exact hit apart from the unresolved ones; matchesExpected true.
expected: build.py exits 0 and the result matches the example's expected verdict: violation: Pricing#total refuted on new Quote(new Money(0), 1), 0 before and 1 after, replayed on a JVM; POST /quotes refuted too

resources.notes: two compare runs of under a second each on seven small classes, plus javac and the app's tests; a cargo build of jvmcontract if the release binary is missing
